instruction: Convert the Baby Justin Bieber video file on the desktop to MP3 audio format using VLC. The output file should be named "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" and saved on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting video to MP3 audio using VLC. Evaluator verifies the output file is in valid MP3/MPEG audio format using file type detection.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: MP3 file exists at correct location (/home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.mp3) with correct format
Getter logic is sound: uses 'file -b' command to detect file type and correctly identifies MP3 format via multiple indicators (audio + mpeg/mp3/layer iii)
Metric logic is correct: properly compares is_mp3 boolean flag and handles edge cases (non-dict results)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file type info -> metric compares boolean flag -> expected value (is_mp3: true) is semantically appropriate
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('is_mp3') without incorrect 'rules' nesting
Minor limitation: evaluator doesn't verify that VLC was actually used for conversion (only checks output exists with correct format)
Minor limitation: evaluator doesn't verify conversion actually occurred from the source video (user could have placed an existing MP3 file)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding verification that source video file still exists to confirm conversion occurred (not just file placement)
Consider checking file modification timestamp to ensure it was created after task started
Consider adding basic audio duration check to verify the MP3 contains actual audio content from the video
